stock.description: Town Ray Holdings Limited, operating through its subsidiaries, specializes in the production and global distribution of electrically powered household appliances. Its market reach extends across Europe, Asia, the United States, and various other international regions. The company's diverse product range includes garment care items such as steam generator irons, garment steamers, and conventional steam irons. They also supply a variety of cooking appliances, encompassing coffee machines, steam cookers, and other kitchen-related devices. Furthermore, their offerings comprise consumer electronics, cleaning solutions, and air purification systems. Established in 2005, the firm maintains its primary operational base in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong, and functions as a subordinate entity of Modern Expression Limited.
